items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: He was taught by John. That was in his band.

ctx.x: And what about, uh, Joe Robichaud? Didn't he have a girlfriend like that or something? That, that, that, that, didn't Joe Robichaud have a girlfriend that sang or danced or something? I'm trying to remember.
